defs.def: a thick slice of good quality beef 牛排

ex.s: The origin of “hamburger” was a hard beef steak called “Hamburg steak”, eaten without bread.
ex.t: 'hamburger'的起源是一种叫做'汉堡牛排'的硬牛肉饼，吃的时候不配面包。

ex.s: A fellow diner at the restaurant, Zhang Tao, was choking on some steak.
ex.t: 餐厅里的一位食客，张涛，被一块牛排噎住了。

ex.s: Then he ordersadishcalled"steaktartare".When the dish arrives, he is shocked to discover that "steak tartare" is actually raw hamburger.
ex.t: 然后他点了一道叫做'鞑靼牛排'的菜。菜端上来时，他震惊地发现'鞑靼牛排'其实就是生汉堡肉。

ex.s: I was starving and rushed to put a steak on the barbecue.
ex.t: 我饿坏了，急忙把一块牛排放在烧烤架上。

defs.def: a thick slice of any type of meat 肉排；肉块
beef that is not of the best quality, often sold in small pieces and used in pies, stews, etc. 常构成复合词
a large thick piece of fish 鱼排；鱼块
